title: Engineering Scalable Apps.
presentation_text: I'm a Software Engineer from Málaga, building scalable apps with Java Spring Boot and React TypeScript. I work across the full development lifecycle and enjoy clean architectures, maintainable code, and modern tools like Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Fluent in French, Spanish, Portuguese, and English, I thrive in multicultural teams, and yes, I bring Málaga sunshine to stand-ups! ☀️😄

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of projects I have worked on.

project1.title: The Imposter
project1.description: Free online social deduction game: choose categories or play with custom words in to discover who the imposter is. Full stack built with Java Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL.

project2.title: Client Contract API
project2.description: An RESTful API using the factory design pattern in Java Spring Boot to manage clients and contracts.

project3.title: Crypto Trading Simulator
project3.description: A full stack web application simulating cryptocurrency trading with real-time price updates, virtual account management, and transaction history.

currentRole.title: BESTSELLER - Full Stack Developer & Mentor
currentRole.description: Leading frontend and backend mentoring activities as the primary mentor for a new cohort of developers joining the team. I lead the development of an end-to-end automation platform for the sample distribution process used by sales representatives after customer purchases, while working with large datasets, query optimization, critical path analysis, and backend performance improvements across distributed microservices.

previousRole.title: BESTSELLER - Junior Full Stack Developer
previousRole.description: Contributed to business-critical projects including automation of customer order confirmations, value-added customer services, and automatic replenishment of Never Out Of Stock (NOOS) products across retail stores. Implemented monitoring, logging, and synthetic end-to-end testing with Datadog. Acted as a secondary mentor for new trainees, supporting their onboarding and technical growth.

earlierRole.title: BESTSELLER - Trainee Full Stack Developer
earlierRole.description: Contributed to React and Spring Boot applications under mentorship, gaining hands-on experience with distributed microservices and cloud-native technologies. Worked with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, and MySQL in production environments. Participated in testing, bug fixing, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies while progressively taking ownership of development tasks.

internRole.title: NTT DATA Europe & LATAM - Software Engineer Intern
internRole.description: Developed ETL processes using PL/SQL and built business dashboards with Tableau and Qlik Sense.
